none: PAS WILT-DAE27F: Roman T shaped brooch
contea di ritrovamento: Wiltshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

A fragment of copper alloy Roman T shaped brooch dating to AD 50 - 150. The fragment consists of the head and part of the bow. The top of the pin is present. The bow, C shaped in cross section, narrows after leaving the head ending at an old break.
